raw:
[
  {"speaker": "Sasiette", "text": "Our neighbour is Holroald."},
  {"speaker": "Leisa", "text": "Traffic’s so slow tonight."},
  {"speaker": "Sasiette", "text": "Ugh, same here. Barely moving."},
  {"speaker": "Leisa", "text": "Hope it clears up soon."},
  {"speaker": "Sasiette", "text": "Fingers crossed, this is taking forever."},
  {"speaker": "Leisa", "text": "At least we’re inching along."},
  {"speaker": "Sasiette", "text": "I went to an audition three days ago."},
  {"speaker": "Leisa", "text": "Traffic’s finally moving a little."},
  {"speaker": "Sasiette", "text": "Linir is my boss."},
  {"speaker": "Leisa", "text": "This drive feels endless."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I’m still thinking about that little trip. Are you leaning toward a beach weekend or somewhere quiet inland?"},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Random fact: my cat’s name is Ylkin."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"The coast sounds tempting to me. I could use a few days with nothing much on the schedule."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Same, I’d love a slow trip with time to wander and not rush anywhere."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Maybe we could pack light and figure out the details as we go."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"That sounds perfect. I’m just hoping for a comfy place to stay and a bit of sunshine."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I’ll check what the weather might be like before I decide what to bring."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Good call. I always bring too much, so I’m trying to keep my bag simple this time."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I went to a picnic last Friday, and it made me want to spend more time outside."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Now I’m even more in the mood for a trip. A relaxed weekend by the water would be lovely."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"These headlines are a lot to take in tonight. I keep checking the news and hoping for something lighter."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Brakesette is our daughter."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"The news cycle really doesn’t slow down, does it? Every time I check, there’s another update."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I know, it’s hard to keep up with all the headlines."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Same here. I’m ready for a calm little stretch in the news."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"That would be nice. Even a few quiet hours would feel like a break."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I keep refreshing the news feed like it’ll suddenly turn cheerful."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Ha, I’ve done that too. The updates just keep coming."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Maybe I should put my phone down and let the headlines wait till morning."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Quaroir is our boss."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Probably a good call. It’s a lot of news for one late night."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Yeah, I’ll stop scrolling soon. These stories can wait a few hours."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Agreed. Let’s hope tomorrow’s news feels a little easier to read."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"We went to a hackathon two days ago, and I'm still thinking about it."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Have you been watching that TV series lately? I finally caught up."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Yeah, the new episodes are so good. I keep saying one more and then watching another."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Quaroir's favourite food is risotto, apparently."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"The latest episode had such a good twist. I did not see it coming."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Same! The pacing has been great, and the ending was perfect."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I work for Hapo Insurance, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I started another series, but I think this one might be even better."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Ooh, what kind of show is it? I need something new to watch."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I work for Holri Books, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I like when a show takes its time building the story."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Totally, it makes the big moments feel earned."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Exactly. I'm already looking forward to the next episode."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Now I want to rewatch the whole thing from the beginning."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Traffic's crawling already this morning."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Same here, it feels like every light is red."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"My parrot's name is Sovpip."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"The road is barely moving past the turn."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I left early and I'm still stuck."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"It's moving in tiny bursts, then stopping again."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I play drums when I get some time."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Hopefully the line clears up soon."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"There's a little more space ahead now."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Maybe we'll get through this stretch before long."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"It's still slow, but at least we're rolling."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Holroald lives in Sitirford."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Hope the rest of the drive is smoother."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Just a heads-up: Linir is allergic to shellfish, so I'm keeping that in mind."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Did you catch the news this morning? Feels like every headline is a lot before breakfast."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I skimmed it over coffee. The latest updates are already making the rounds."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Same here, I’m trying to get the gist without getting sucked into a full scroll."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Yeah, just the main headlines for me. The morning feed is busy as ever."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Random fact about me: my favourite food is curry."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Have you seen the coverage about the new developments? Hard to keep up with it all."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"A little, yeah. I’m just checking the brief updates between getting ready."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"Same, the headlines keep refreshing faster than I can read them."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"By the way, Brakesette's favourite colour is maroon."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"The news cycle is relentless this morning. I might take a screen break soon."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Good call. I’ll do one last quick check, then get on with the morning."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I work as a receptionist, so mornings get busy fast."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"We went to an opera last Wednesday, and I’m still thinking about it."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I’m thinking of keeping my getaway pretty low-key, maybe somewhere warm. Have you picked anything yet?"},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"We checked out an auction two days ago, which was a fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I might take a short trip and leave plenty of time to relax. What kind of break sounds good to you?"},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I’m leaning toward a quiet escape with lots of time to wander around."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"My favourite food is pierogi, hands down."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"I’d love a trip with a bit of sunshine and no packed schedule."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"That sounds lovely. I’m hoping to keep my plans flexible, too."},
  {"speaker":"Leisa","text":"Maybe I’ll just pack light and see where the mood takes me."},
  {"speaker":"Sasiette","text":"I went to a carnival last Friday, and it was such a lively evening."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Are you still watching that mystery series? I’m trying not to stay up for one more episode."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I am, and the new season is so good. The little clues are making me overthink everything."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I went to a recital last Saturday, and it was really lovely."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"That fantasy series has such a good atmosphere. I keep getting pulled into it."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I just started a comedy series, and it’s perfect for a late night like this."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I know what you mean. I put on one episode and suddenly I’m three in."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"By the way, Saezine is my roommate."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I’m rewatching that mystery series now, and somehow it’s still fun even when I know the twists."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Also, Sovan is my landlord."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"The sci-fi series I mentioned has such a strange plot, but I can’t stop watching."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I might put on one more episode of that comedy series before I try to sleep."}
]

[
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "I stayed up way too late playing that game. Just one more round turned into five 😅"},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Haha, I know the feeling. I’ve been trying to beat that tricky level."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "The new outfit options are fun, too. I keep changing mine between rounds."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "I went to a concert last Friday and it was so fun."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Nice! I’m taking a break from my game for a bit this morning."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "I just started a new quest, and now I need to know how it ends."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "The little puzzles in that game are surprisingly clever."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Right? I got stuck on one, then felt silly when I figured it out."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "I’m allergic to pollen, so this time of year can be a bit rough."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Hope you’re doing okay! I’m going to try a few more rounds later."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Sounds good. I’m aiming to unlock one more level today."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Good luck! I’ll see if I can finally get past that boss."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I’ve been browsing for a new jacket all afternoon. Shopping is more fun when there’s a good sale."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I picked up a cozy sweater today and I’m already glad I went. I might look for boots next."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Sovan’s a social worker, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I’m trying to find a nice bag, but I keep getting distracted by all the scarves."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I went to a museum last Friday, and it was such a nice change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I found a cute pair of gloves while shopping. They’ll be perfect when it gets chilly."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I’m on the hunt for a comfy pair of jeans. Shopping takes forever when I can’t decide."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Same, I tried on a few things and only liked one. At least it was on sale!"},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I’ve been looking at coats, but I can’t choose between the dark one and the light one."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I went to an aquarium last Wednesday, and it was lovely to wander around for a while."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I finally found a scarf I like. Now I’m trying not to add more things to my basket."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"That’s always the hard part! I went in for one thing and came home with a whole bag."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I went to a wedding three days ago, and it was a lovely time."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I might do a little more shopping this weekend and see if I can find those boots."}
]

[
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "It’s so gloomy out this afternoon."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Yeah, that gray sky makes it feel later than it is."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "At least it’s not pouring."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "True, just a bit of drizzle here."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Feels chilly too, especially with this wind."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "I’m hoping it clears up soon."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Kesy always perks up when it rains."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "The clouds look like they might finally be thinning."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Maybe we’ll get a little sunshine after all."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "That would make this afternoon feel much nicer."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "I work for Bralin Brewing, and this weather has me wishing for a brighter day."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Same here; a bit of sun would be lovely."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Fingers crossed the clouds move along soon."}
]

[
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Morning! Did you catch the news about the unusually warm spell?"},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "A little—feels like every update is about the weather lately."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Yeah, and now they’re saying the forecast could swing colder by tonight."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Classic. I’m just hoping for a quiet morning and a decent cup of coffee."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Random fact: my dog is named Ruble, and he’s already wide awake."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "That’s adorable. The news has me wanting a slow morning instead of another forecast."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Also, I grew up in Karostead, so I’m used to mornings that start this early."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "I can barely process headlines before coffee, honestly."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "Same. At least the sky looks calm from here."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "I saw a piece about how the cold snap might not last long."},
  {"speaker": "Sitavette", "text": "That would be nice; I’m ready for a few brighter mornings."},
  {"speaker": "Tavelle", "text": "Fingers crossed. I’ll take any good news before the day gets going."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Saezine's parrot is named Tirble, which is such a fun name."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Still thinking about your birthday present? I hope it feels like you."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Yeah, I have a little idea, but I'm keeping it secret for now."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Ooh, I love a surprise. Is it something cozy?"},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Maybe! I think you'll get a lot of use out of it."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"That sounds perfect. I always appreciate a present I can actually enjoy."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Exactly, and I think this one will make you smile."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"By the way, my parrot is named Baix."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Now I'm even more curious about my birthday present haha."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I live in Kadorton, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Haha, you'll have to wait just a bit longer to find out."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Fair, I'll try to be patient. I'm already excited."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I can't wait to see your reaction when you open it."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"You know how to build suspense. I'm counting down already."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Traffic's crawling today. I barely moved for a few minutes."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Same here, it feels like every light is red."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Ganwyn is my neighbour."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"The traffic is so stop and go right now."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I went to a workshop last Friday."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"It’s taking forever to get anywhere with these backups."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Traffic’s eased up a little, thankfully."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I’m still inching along. What a slog."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"My daughter is Keswyn."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Hope the traffic clears soon. This is ridiculous."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I finally tried that cozy farming game last night. Somehow I spent the whole time rearranging my little garden."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"That’s the best part! I got distracted decorating my house and forgot to check on my crops."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Same, I keep saying I’ll finish one more task and then suddenly it’s morning in the game."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"I live in Riezhaven, by the way. It’s nice having a quiet place to play."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I’ve been trying a puzzle game too, but one level has me completely stumped."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Those tricky levels are so satisfying when they finally click. I usually need a snack break first."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Keswyn’s rabbit is named Ashix, and apparently Ashix loves hanging out near the game console."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"That’s adorable. I’d probably end up taking more breaks to say hi than actually playing."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"Ganwyn is allergic to sesame, so I’m keeping that in mind when we pick snacks."},
  {"speaker":"Tavelle","text":"Good call. I’m in the mood for a few rounds of that racing game later."},
  {"speaker":"Sitavette","text":"I’m up for it! I’ll practice my turns before you leave me in the dust again."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I’m still getting used to my new phone. The screen feels so bright!"},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Orir is my teammate."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"The battery on my new phone lasts way longer than I expected."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I went to a museum last Saturday, and it was a nice change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"My new phone takes surprisingly clear pictures, even indoors."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I like how light my new phone feels in my hand."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Still exploring all the settings on this new phone 😄"},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"The keyboard on my new phone is taking a little getting used to."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"My dog’s name is Moble, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I’ve been using my new phone to listen to music, and the sound is great."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I’m happy with my new phone so far. The screen is lovely for reading."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Are you still thinking of a quiet getaway, or are you leaning toward somewhere by the water?"},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Somewhere by the water sounds nice. I’m hoping to keep the trip simple and pack light."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I play the ukulele when I’m winding down."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I might take the train and leave the schedule open for a little exploring."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"That sounds relaxing. I’m still deciding whether to bring a book for the ride."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Definitely bring one, and maybe a light jacket in case it gets chilly."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Good call. I want to keep my bag small so getting around is easy."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I went to a reunion last Friday, and it was a fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Hope the travel day goes smoothly. Are you planning to bring just a carry-on?"},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"That’s the plan. I’d rather have extra room for snacks than lug around a big bag."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I went to a rodeo last Saturday, and it was a fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Nice! For the trip, I’m thinking of taking it slow and leaving plenty of time to wander."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"That sounds perfect. I’m hoping for an easy ride and a little time to unwind."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"It’s so warm out this afternoon. Hope you’ve found some shade."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Bapip’s been chirping away by the open window all afternoon."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"There’s a little breeze now, at least. Feels nicer than earlier."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Yeah, the air’s finally moving a bit."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Still feels pretty muggy, though."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"For sure. I’m hoping it cools off soon."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"The clouds are making it feel a little less intense."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Orir works as a barber, and is great at it."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"That breeze is picking up again. Much better."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"It really is. The shade feels lovely right now."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"A bit of sun just came back, but it’s still pleasant."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I’ll take this over the sticky heat from earlier."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Same here. Hopefully it stays comfortable for a while."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Have you started thinking about your next trip, or are you still keeping it open?"},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"My favourite food is risotto, easily."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I might aim for a few days somewhere by the coast. Have you picked a length yet?"},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Not yet, I’m leaning toward somewhere warm where I can walk around and take it slow."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"That sounds ideal. I’m trying to keep my plans flexible so I can decide when I’m closer."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Same here, though I should probably figure out whether I want a short getaway or a longer break."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"A short trip could be nice. I’m tempted to pack light and leave room for spontaneous detours."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"My neighbour is Saia."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Would you rather have a packed itinerary or leave most of the days free?"},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Mostly free, I think. It’d be nice to explore at my own pace and not rush around."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"One thing about me: I’m allergic to sesame."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I’m leaning toward a place with good walking paths and somewhere peaceful to unwind."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"That sounds like a great reset. I should start sketching out a loose plan soon."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Same! I’ll browse a little and see what kind of trip feels right."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"How was your weekend? Hope you got some time to relax."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Pretty good! Took it easy and caught up on a few things. How about yours?"},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I went to a picnic last Saturday, and it was such a nice way to spend the day."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"That sounds lovely! My weekend was calm, which I really needed."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Same here, a quiet weekend can be the best."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Totally. I feel recharged for the week now."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Glad you got a chance to unwind! I’m easing back into things too."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I went to an exhibition two days ago, and it was a fun change of pace."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Nice! Sounds like you had a pretty good weekend overall."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I did! Hope your week is off to a good start too."}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Any fun plans for the weekend? I’m hoping to take it easy."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"My cat’s name is Yapip, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"That sounds nice. I might just stay in and recharge."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Same here, a quiet weekend sounds perfect."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I could use some slow mornings and no rush to do anything."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Absolutely, I’m looking forward to relaxing too."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Saia grew up in Venbamoor, by the way."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I’m hoping to get outside a bit if the weather’s nice."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"My landlord is Leor, just mentioning it while I figure out weekend plans."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Hope you get a restful weekend!"} 
]

[
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Leor lives in Haezport."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"I’m still trying to find a birthday present that feels just right."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"Maybe something cozy, like a soft blanket?"},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"That’s a good idea. I saw a really nice one earlier."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"A useful present can be sweet without being too fancy."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"True, and it could be wrapped up with a little ribbon."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I always like a bit of sparkle on the wrapping."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Same! I might add a handwritten card too."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"That would make it feel extra thoughtful."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Galith is my cousin."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I bet the blanket would be lovely in a calm color."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Maybe a warm blue, with a simple pattern."},
  {"speaker":"Linisho","text":"I went to a recital last Friday."},
  {"speaker":"Sovgalorn","text":"Sounds like I’ve got my present idea, then!"}
]

[
  {"speaker":"Viena","text":"I’m already thinking about coffee and it’s barely morning."},
  {"speaker":"Kesus","text":"Same, I could really go for a strong cup right now."},
  {"speaker":"Viena","text":"I went to a rodeo last Saturday, and it was such a fun time."},
  {"speaker":"Kesus","text":"Coffee sounds extra good when I’m up this early."},
  {"speaker":"Viena","text":"I might make another cup in a minute."},
  {"speaker":"Kesus","text":"I went to an opera last Wednesday, and I’m still thinking about it."},
  {"speaker":"Viena","text":"A little coffee would make this morning much better."},
  {"speaker":"Kesus","text":"I’m sipping mine slowly so it lasts."},
